reviewLimits: Own flat drawing and ordinal-to-bank mapping authored for this exact selection ID; no photograph/manufacturer artwork embedded.

Both visual reference assets were inspected and their hashes verified; they remain community_unverified. The primary manufacturer texts verify SKU, fixed interfaces, nominal dimensions and power topology, not every illustrated mechanical detail.
Only fixed RJ45 Ethernet, empty SFP/SFP+ cages and one fixed AC inlet are connectable. USB-A AUX, USB-C console, reset, LEDs, earth and mechanical apertures are inert details.
Optical transceivers, patch-cord media, live link/LED state, stacking configuration and optional modules are not preinstalled or inferred. No passthrough circuit is created.
PoE capability is descriptive manufacturer data only; budget negotiation, delivery, live state and electrical protection are not simulated by these groups.
QuickSpecs metric values are retained rather than rounded installation-guide dimensions; nominal measurements do not certify rack brackets, cooling, cable bend radius or clearance.
Shared rear image/geometry is deliberately reused only for the documented24/48 fixed-PSU family, with separate compact rear; repeated assets do not create extra model identities.
1U rack occupation is stated by the manufacturer configuration rows; this does not claim an installed four-post accessory or universal rack compatibility.
Odd RJ45 ordinals are above even ordinals in each twelve-port bank. The four optical cages use labels49-52.
Fixed PSU presents one rear AC inlet; C13 cord specification does not create an extra PSU or device DC endpoint.
Manufacturer Class4 PoE budget370W, up to30W per applicable access port; descriptive only, not an initialized operational PoE state.
